pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, feathered edge gradients; spatial area is larger on the central flank and decreases in size toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white negative space forming a web-like topology; junction nodes consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections with variable pixel thickness across pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the cervical-dorsal ridge, appearing as a dark rufous fringe against the background.
